blocked_or_deferred_registry_entries.blocking_reason: Native FP32 checkpoint verified locally (999,352,320 tied parameters, 4/4 token_checks match, 2.68e-6 KV-cache parity), but CPU PyTorch FP32 decode (~3.5 tok/s, ~146s for 512 unigram tokens) exceeds Research v2's hard 30s per-turn transport timeout while the workstation RTX 5080 (16 GiB) was leased by concurrent external vramorama jobs (squid5080-serve / gym-b25). Full 32-case held-panel rollout was executed via the separate registered deployment arm baby-goblin-10m-v2-q4km (~38 tok/s CPU, 0 timeouts).

Pinned BF16 weights and config hashes verified locally and loaded natively in transformers 5.24.1 (3,975,229,440 params, 2 recurrent loops, per_loop KV cache, 8.26 GiB RAM). Two-loop BF16 prefill+decode on CPU exceeds Research v2's 30s per-turn deadline and triggered host paging alongside active external vramorama GPU jobs (RTX 5080 15.6/15.9 GiB in use by squid5080-serve with gym-b25 queued); deferred pending free GPU lease.

Pinned BF16 weights and config hashes verified locally (4,169,800,704 actual total parameters, num_loops=2; manual DynamicCache greedy loop resolved transformers 5.24.1 cache-kwarg incompatibility). Two-loop 4.17B BF16 execution on CPU exceeded the 29s worker / 30s transport per-turn deadline on smoke test while workstation RTX 5080 remained leased by external vramorama jobs; deferred pending free GPU lease.
blocked_or_deferred_registry_entries.parameter_label_note: 3B marketing label excludes embeddings; verified total checkpoint parameters = 4,169,800,704.

blocked_or_deferred_registry_entries.blocking_reason: Pinned BF16 weights, PrefixLM all-ones token_type_ids adapter, and both condition envelopes (direct and synth,cot) verified locally (1,182,795,264 parameters, H2/L3 = 8x effective inner recurrence passes). Effective 8x recurrent depth exceeded the 28.5s worker / 30s transport per-turn deadline on CPU while workstation RTX 5080 remained leased by external vramorama jobs; deferred pending free GPU lease.

Pinned Qwen/Qwen3-4B BF16 was evaluated on the full 32-case held panel with thinking_mode=disabled (6/32 turns completed under 29s, 26/32 hit 29s CPU deadline). The separate thinking_mode=enabled variant exceeded the 29s CPU turn deadline on 100% of smoke probes due to extended <think> chains at ~2.5 tok/s CPU; deferred pending free GPU lease.

Native mixed-precision (nvfp4-mxfp8-bf16, ~20.2 GB) lacks a local Inkling2LoopForConditionalGeneration serving runtime and exceeds the workstation's 16 GiB RTX 5080 VRAM (which is also leased externally). The separate local IQ4_NL GGUF deployment arm (17.63 GB, SHA e9f70a16..., 3 passes via --override-kv inkling2_loop.loop.count=int:3) timed out at 240s llama-server startup from virtual Drive storage and previously required >15.7 GiB VRAM + 180s turn timeouts in dedicated Vulkan pilots, exceeding Research v2's 30s per-turn cap without authorized external GPU provisioning.
